create.name: Orlaith O'Sullivan
create.bio:
Orlaith O'Sullivan is an Irish mindfulness teacher in the Plum Village tradition of Thich Nhat Hanh, whom she has followed for more than two decades. She is an ordained lay member of his Order of Interbeing and coordinates Wake Up Schools, Plum Village's international work on mindfulness in education. She was also among the first people certified by the VIA Institute on Character to teach Mindfulness-Based Strengths Practice, and she brings that strengths-based approach into much of her teaching. She holds a doctorate and has a long love of poetry, which runs through her retreats.

From Dublin, where she started two local sanghas for adults and for families, she teaches children, teenagers, adults, schools and workplaces. Her offerings include online mornings that pair silent practice with poems, Winterlight, a seasonal on-demand journey through the dark months, day retreats in Ireland, the Calm Café course on short restorative breaks, and individual sessions. She keeps a library of free guided meditations and deep relaxations on her website and on Insight Timer, and her style is warm, practical and playful, with plenty of rest built in.

courses.title: Winterlight
courses.description: An on-demand seasonal course that moves from the dark of winter towards spring in three stages, with weekly recorded talks, guided practices, poems and printable reflections. It opens each year around Halloween and can be started at any point in the winter.

courses.title: Day Retreat: Fresh New Year
courses.description: A gentle in-person day of practice in Duleek, County Meath, to open the new year. The day mixes guided and silent practice with time to journal, reflect or rest.

courses.title: The Calm Café
courses.description: A self-paced course on turning short breaks in the working day into moments of real rest. Each lesson offers a brief practice for relaxing and refreshing your energy.

courses.title: 1:1 Session with Orlaith
courses.description: Individual mindfulness sessions, in person or online, shaped around your own practice at home and at work. She asks people to get in touch by email before booking.

courses.title: Poetry Retreat: The Tender Gravity of Kindness
courses.description: A recorded mindfulness and poetry morning to follow at home, with poems by MacNeice, Rilke, Naomi Shihab Nye and others used as meditations. It arrives as a downloadable PDF with links to the recordings.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of free downloadable meditations from her website, including a springtime practice and a longer rest in open presence. The recordings are offered on a donation basis.

free_resources.title: Deep Relaxation
free_resources.description: A long guided body scan on Insight Timer for letting the body settle completely. It can be used before sleep or simply as a time of rest.

free_resources.title: The Five Remembrances
free_resources.description: A short guided reflection on Insight Timer based on a classic Buddhist contemplation of change and impermanence, as taught in the Plum Village tradition.

free_resources.title: Relaxation
free_resources.description: A free downloadable deep relaxation on her website, guiding attention slowly through the body. It comes with a short explanation of why relaxation belongs in mindfulness practice.
